edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks documents or information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, the work-product doctrine, common-interest protection, or any other applicable privilege, immunity, or protection. Defendant will withhold privileged or protected materials on those grounds and will identify such withheld materials on a privilege log as required by applicable rules and any governing order.
edits.name: Revise General Objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to the objections stated in these responses, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents located after a reasonable search of the sources identified above. Defendant is not withholding responsive, non-privileged documents based on general objections alone. Defendant will produce documents on a rolling basis and will substantially complete production by close of business Friday, except for documents requiring further privilege review, documents later discovered through continuing reasonable search efforts, or documents subject to unresolved objections stated in response to specific requests.

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds documents categorically or identifies redactions rather than full-document withholdings, Defendant will do so in a manner sufficient to permit assessment of the asserted protection.
edits.name: Revise Privilege Log Statement

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION.
